title: Platforms
description:
Platforms is a platforming game with numerous features and levels and is inspired by retro platforming games!

Platforms is currently in early access.Features include:• Numerous levels to play

• Early version of the level editor

• Level menu which allows replaying previously completed levels

• Ability to customize your player character with coins earned from completing levels

• Save/load easily with quick save and quick load
Planned features:• Steam workshop for custom-made levels.

• New enemy types

• Larger levels

• Better collision detection

• More settings

• Overall improvements
description_short: Platforms is a platforming game with numerous features and levels. Customization, level editor and 15+ levels to play.
